scripts.typecheck: pnpm run frontend:typecheck && pnpm run backend:typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm run frontend:lint && pnpm run backend:lint
scripts.test: pnpm run frontend:test && pnpm run backend:test
scripts.qa:docs: pnpm run repo:check:local && git diff --check -- AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md docs package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml frontend/package.json backend/package.json shared/package.json .github scripts .husky supabase/config.toml frontend/vite.config.ts frontend/vitest.config.ts frontend/playwright.config.ts frontend/eslint.config.js frontend/tsconfig.json frontend/tailwind.config.cjs backend/tsconfig.json backend/vitest.config.ts
scripts.qa:front: pnpm run repo:check:local && pnpm run frontend:typecheck && pnpm run frontend:lint && pnpm run frontend:test && pnpm run frontend:error-compliance
scripts.qa:back: pnpm run repo:check:local && pnpm run backend:lint && pnpm run backend:typecheck && pnpm run backend:test
scripts.qa:fast: pnpm run qa:front && pnpm run backend:lint && pnpm run backend:typecheck && pnpm run backend:test
scripts.qa:ci: pnpm run repo:check:local && pnpm run frontend:typecheck && pnpm run frontend:lint && pnpm --dir frontend run test:coverage && pnpm run frontend:error-compliance && pnpm run frontend:build && pnpm run backend:lint && pnpm run backend:typecheck && pnpm run backend:test && pnpm run backend:test:integration
